theorem quotient_image_connectedComponent {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (p : X → Y) (hq : IsQuotientMap p)
    (hX : ∀ y : Y, IsConnected (p ⁻¹' ({y} : Set Y))) (x : X) :
    p '' connectedComponent x = connectedComponent (p x) := by
  first
  | exact hq.image_connectedComponent hX x
  | exact IsQuotientMap.image_connectedComponent hq hX x
  | apply subset_antisymm
    · exact (isConnected_connectedComponent.image p hq.continuous.continuousOn).subset_connectedComponent
        (mem_image_of_mem p mem_connectedComponent)
    · have h_pre : p ⁻¹' (p '' connectedComponent x) = connectedComponent x := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · intro hz
          obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := hz
